name: io.github.SuresoftTechnologies/suresoft-cover
title: SURESOFT COVER
description: Answers questions about SURESOFT COVER code coverage from its official product page.

tools.name: cover_overview
tools.description: What SURESOFT COVER is: the definition and overview from the official COVER product page, with the list of page sections that cover_get_section can return.

tools.name: cover_list_sections
tools.description: Lists every section and subsection of the COVER product page with its URL.

tools.name: cover_get_section
tools.description: Returns one section of the COVER product page, such as key features, editions, use cases or industry standards. Use a title from cover_list_sections.

section.description: Section title or anchor, e.g. "Key features".

tools.name: cover_search_faq
tools.description: Searches the frequently asked questions on the COVER product page. Leave query empty to list every question.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "MISRA" or "air-gapped".

tools.name: cover_supported_languages
tools.description: Languages, versions and development environments COVER supports, from the COVER page and the Supported Languages page.

language.description: Optional: limit to one language, e.g. "C/C++", "Java".

tools.name: cover_ai_integration
tools.description: How COVER works with AI and AI coding agents, as described on the SURESOFT site.

tools.name: cover_resources
tools.description: White papers, product materials and videos listed in the COVER resource library.

tools.name: cover_contact
tools.description: How to contact Suresofttech about COVER: inquiries and demo requests.
